item.title: Elmos sales rise 15% as chip demand boosts margins
item.summary: Elmos Semiconductor has reported double-digit sales growth and stronger profitability for the first half of 2026, supported by continued demand for its automotive semiconductor products. The German chip supplier also generated substantially more cash while keeping capital expenditure at a relatively low level.
